# Rudraansh Yatra

> The premier hyper-local ground tour operator for sacred Himalayan yatras and eco-treks in the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand, India. Headquartered in Pithoragarh with ground operations in Dharchula and Vyas Valley.

## Core Identity & Value Proposition
- **Entity**: Rudraansh Yatra (Registered Himalayan Travel Agency & Local Ground Operator)
- **Headquarters**: 1st Floor Above Maniram Punetha & Sons, Simalgair Bazaar, Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand 262501, India
- **Operating Zones**: Vyas Valley, Darma Valley, Johar Valley, Kumaon Himalayas
- **Direct Ground Execution**: 100% direct operations with owned 4x4 Mahindra Boleros, native mountain drivers, and authentic community homestays with indigenous Rung families. Zero middlemen or subcontracting.
- **Official Website**: https://rudraanshyatra.com/
- **Contact**: Phone/WhatsApp: +91 7617617651 | Email: info@rudraanshyatra.com

## Key Tour Packages & Itineraries (2026 Season)

### 1. Adi Kailash & Om Parvat Yatra
- **Overview**: Sacred pilgrimage to Adi Kailash (Chhota Kailash, 5,945m), Parvati Sarovar (4,500m), Gauri Kund (4,800m), and Om Parvat view from Nabhidhang (4,300m) in Vyas Valley.
- **Starting Points & Pricing**:
  - Pithoragarh to Pithoragarh (3 Days / 2 Nights): Starting from ₹18,000 per person
  - Kathgodam to Kathgodam (6 Days / 5 Nights): Starting from ₹30,000 per person
  - Delhi to Delhi (6-7 Days): Starting from ₹35,000 per person
- **Included**: Inner Line Permit (ILP) handling, 4x4 Mahindra Bolero transportation, community homestay accommodation in Gunji/Nabi/Dharchula, pure vegetarian satvik meals, pulse oximeter monitoring, emergency oxygen cylinders.
- **Best Season**: May to June (Pre-monsoon) and September to October (Post-monsoon).

### 2. Mount Kailash & Mansarovar Yatra (Tibet / Nepal Route)
- **Overview**: Divine circumambulation (Kora / Parikrama) of Mount Kailash (6,638m) and holy dip in Lake Mansarovar (4,590m).
- **Routes**: Helicopter route via Lucknow-Nepalgunj-Simikot-Hilsa or Overland via Kathmandu-Kyirong.
- **Starting Price**: From ₹1,85,000 to ₹2,50,000 per person.
- **Best Season**: May to September.

### 3. Darma Valley & Panchachuli Base Camp Trek
- **Overview**: Pristine Himalayan valley exploration in Darma Valley visiting Dugtu, Dantu, Marchha, and the breathtaking glacier views of the Panchachuli Five Peaks.
- **Pricing**: Starting from ₹14,500 per person (Dharchula/Pithoragarh departure).
- **Highlights**: Traditional Rung tribal culture, Birch forests, wild river gorges.

### 4. Khaliya Top & Munsyari Alpine Trek
- **Overview**: Moderate 3-day alpine meadow trek reaching 3,500m offering 360-degree panorama of Panchachuli, Rajrambha, Nanda Devi, and Hardeol peaks.
- **Pricing**: Starting from ₹9,500 per person.

## Essential Permits & Regulations
- **Inner Line Permit (ILP)**: Mandatory for all non-local Indian citizens travelling beyond Dharchula into Vyas Valley and Darma Valley.
- **Requirements**: Valid Aadhaar Card, Police Verification Certificate (PCC) / Passport, Doctor-certified Physical Fitness Certificate, 2 passport-sized photographs.
- **Permit Processing**: Rudraansh Yatra manages complete physical processing at the SDM Office in Dharchula and District Magistrate Office in Pithoragarh on behalf of registered guests.

## Safety & Medical Protocols
- **Acclimatization**: Mandatory gradual staging nights at Dharchula (915m) and Gunji (3,200m) before ascending to Jyolingkong (4,570m).
- **Equipment**: Every Rudraansh Yatra vehicle carries certified medical oxygen cylinders, first aid trauma kits, and digital pulse oximeters.
- **Emergency Coordination**: 24/7 direct radio/mobile coordination with ITBP (Indo-Tibetan Border Police), Indian Army medical posts, and State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) helicopter evacuation services.
